notes: All Rhino commands and real clicks used newly owned private-Xvfb sessions and public APIs; no user desktop or existing Rhino process was accessed.

The first settings diagnostic failed because the host did not copy its helper module. After fixing packaging, a new session established Enable/Disable/Toggle grammar and disabled initial state. The failed diagnostic is not treated as evidence.
Each mesh-pick request reads, sets, verifies and restores the mesh switch through its English public command prompt. The retained per-case settings records verify restoration.
Mid-only and one-shot Mid did not hover-capture whole mesh wires in these fixtures. Mesh Mid is direct target capture; curve whole-segment hover is not generalized to meshes.

Independent Fraction references use only source wires and recorded camera/click. Mesh Near native targets follow exact projected proximity, but five constrained Rhino x coordinates differ by about 2.325e-5 through 1.1945e-3. No global epsilon was widened, no observed target was fed to snapping, and these five are not full parity matches.

Two Mid targets replay complete ordered geometry, attributes, selection and history at absolute 1e-9, relative 1e-10. Nine controls compare mesh admission only, not the absence of other scene snaps or their model-space positions: the receiving box can itself supply curve Mid. Four controls did not split and have no actual Undo/Redo.

SplitEdge exposes only a constrained x coordinate, not a Rhino unconstrained 3D snap target. Portable source recipes replace only the verified shared box artifact; raw output geometry is retained without numerical normalization.
